item.title: UNMLA To Host My Favorite Lecture: American Poetry Feb. 4
item.description: UNMLA News: The UNM-Los Alamos (UNM-LA) My Favorite Lecture Series 2026 will open with American Poetry: Forests, Places and Robert Frost from 4–5:30 p.m., Wednesday, Feb. 4, in Wallace Hall on the UNM-LA campus. The lecture will be presented by Virgina Grant, Ph.D., who is the English and humanities coordinator at UNM-LA.
